exact: Canonical compiled generic identities, complete selected machine/state AddTransition instruction schedules including cold branches, physical from/to/priority/checker writes and static context declarations.
Validated typed constructor request callee joins canonical machine AddTransition; physical writer offsets join validated executor/condition reader offsets.
conditional: Dictionary Contains/GetItem/set_Item, allocator/type resolver, static-context initializers, collection insertion requests and barriers have opaque effects and normal Win64 return premises.
Runtime RGCTX values and helper results are explicit independent inputs; post-helper heap reads are not equated.
unresolved: Runtime closed Center instance identity, allocator nominal type, initialized MethodInfo, dictionary/list implementation effects, callback selection, object lifetime and capture writer attribution.
